# Stable identifiers

Principles: P01 to P22 (see principles.json).
P01 No borders within borders. P02 Dark to light. P03 No arbitrary left border. P04 Functional tags. P05 Information earns its place. P06 Few colors. P07 One visual language. P08 Familiarity. P09 Simplicity. P10 Minimalism over prevalence. P11 Rectangle Rule. P12 Dividers secondary. P13 No em dashes. P14 No sidebar stacking. P15 Monochromatic selection and focus. P16 Layout diversity. P17 Subtle focus and selection. P18 Mobile navigation breathing room. P19 No washed-out destructive buttons. P20 No decorative placeholder identity. P21 Remove before adding (meta). P22 Exception rule.

Anti-patterns:
AP-001 Nested decorative borders. AP-002 Thick arbitrary left borders. AP-003 Washed-out destructive buttons. AP-004 Excessive accent-colored outlines. AP-005 Decorative tags and status pills. AP-006 Fake placeholder avatars. AP-007 Excessively dense mobile navigation. AP-008 Multiple simultaneous opposing action buttons. AP-009 Redundant Create buttons beside selection dropdowns. AP-010 Unnecessary explanatory copy. AP-011 Stacked navigation sidebars. AP-012 Excessive accent-color usage. AP-013 Decorative gradients and glow. AP-014 Indentation where flat rectangular organization works better. AP-015 Repeated redundant card containers. AP-016 Excessive visible controls.

Presets: preset.notification, preset.confirm-dialog, preset.destructive-button, preset.loading-state, preset.empty-state, preset.interaction-states, preset.context-menu, preset.dropdown.

Checks: CHK-001 and up (checks/rules.json).
